# Get-AvmBicepE2eDeploymentMatrix

## Synopsis

Build native Bicep E2E deployment selections without Azure access.

## Description

Validates mapped module identity and tenant inputs, selects only General
subscriptions through Select-AvmTestSubscription, compiles each runnable
test, and records its reviewed isolation/concurrency evidence. Ignored
tests remain in the returned matrix but do not require credentials,
identity mapping, compilation, or a subscription.

## Syntax

```powershell
Get-AvmBicepE2eDeploymentMatrix [-Root] <string> [-ModulePath] <string> [-TestFiles] <Object[]> [[-PoolJson] <string>] [[-FallbackSubscriptionId] <string>] [[-ModuleClientIds] <string>] [[-TenantId] <string>] [[-RandomSeed] <int>] [-DisplaySubscriptionNames] [-SkipModuleVersionCheck] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## Examples

### EXAMPLE 1

```powershell
Get-AvmBicepE2eDeploymentMatrix -Root $repo -ModulePath $module -TestFiles $tests -FallbackSubscriptionId $subscription -ModuleClientIds $mapping -TenantId $tenant
```

## Outputs

identity, isolation, and concurrency properties.`
